summary: Iteration 89 e2e validated: AI translate, catch-up summary, group polls (create/vote/retract/close), voice-note speed button, translate button in group chat. 14/15 backend tests passing; 1 failure exposes a real backend bug in /api/chats/{id}/summary when count<3. All requested frontend flows work end-to-end.

minor.issue: Spec requires returning {summary:null, reason:'few'} when count<3, but code sets `limit = max(3, min(count, limit))` which forces at least 3 messages to be fetched, so with ≥3 available msgs the endpoint returns a full summary instead of the 'few' short-circuit. Suggest: check `count and count < 3` -> return few, OR only apply the 'few' short-circuit before max().

issues: The FloatingBubbles (kb-hide fixed z-[10000]) overlay can intercept pointer events near the composer, blocking clicks on pill-attach-btn in some viewport states. In real usage this is generally fine because the FAB is above the pill; but automated clicks needed force=True. Consider narrowing pointer-events on the floating overlay when not expanded.

action_items: Fix summary 'few' logic: `limit = max(3, min(count, limit))` should not upgrade count<3 to 3. Return {'summary':None,'reason':'few'} when the requested count is <3 (or when fetched msgs<3 as it already does).
Optional: Make FloatingBubbles container not intercept pointer events when the compact bubble state is inactive, so pill-attach-btn is reachable without force clicks.
critical_code_review_comments: chat_ai.py summary: `count` semantics are inconsistent with the spec (force-min of 3).
polls.py: single-choice `chosen = chosen[:1]` correct; multi-choice keeps unique order via dict.fromkeys — good. `_poll_view` returns non-anonymous voter names — good.
polls.py close_poll: only creator OR chat.admin_id can close (returns 403 otherwise) — verified.
TranslateButton.jsx: translation cached by hash on backend and shows 'Ya está en tu idioma' when same_language; toggle 'Ver original' works.
BrunoAudioWaveform speed button: cycles 1x → 1.5x → 2x → 1x correctly and persists to localStorage bruno_voice_speed; DOM audio.playbackRate reflects the setting.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 6 group messages from viewer2 in group 655d23d2-b133-4188-a95c-bd8a777c04f4 to trigger the catch-up summary card. Created 3 test polls (single, multi, UI poll v2 which was then closed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env. Run tests with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_iteration89_ai_polls_speed.py -v`. The FloatingBubbles overlay requires force=True for clicks near composer. The 'test_summary_few' failure is a genuine backend logic bug in /api/chats/{id}/summary count handling.
rca of the issue: In /app/backend/routers/chat_ai.py line 78: `limit = max(3, min(int(count), limit))` — when caller passes count=2 (or 1), this evaluates to max(3, 2)=3, so the endpoint queries up to 3 messages and returns a full summary. Fix: replace with `if count and int(count) < 3: return {'count':0,'summary':None,'reason':'few'}` before the query, or explicitly set `limit=int(count)` without the max(3, ...) upgrade so len(msgs)<3 triggers the 'few' branch already present at line 83-84.
